definitions.explanation: Describes acting without any plan, forethought, or direction, implying that the approach is unwise and unlikely to produce good results.

examples.japanese: やみくもに⟦{走|はし}り{出|だ}した→走り出す：06679_hashiridasu⟧。
examples.english: I broke into a blind run.

examples.japanese: やみくもに⟦{努力|どりょく}して→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Effort without direction won't produce results.

examples.japanese: ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}め→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧やみくもに⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、かえって⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}させる→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Acting recklessly without gathering information can actually make the situation worse.

notes:
An adverb meaning to act without plan, thought, or direction — blindly and recklessly. Written in kanji as {闇雲|やみくも}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, combining ⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧ (darkness) and ⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧ (cloud), evoking the image of groping blindly through dark clouds.

USAGE:
- Almost always used with a negative implication — acting this way is unwise
- Modifies action verbs: やみくもに + verb
- The na-adjective form やみくもな is also used: やみくもな⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧ (reckless action)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- やみくもに⟦{突|つ}き{進|すす}む→突き進む：07266_tsukisusumu⟧: to charge ahead blindly
- やみくもに⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧: to believe blindly
- やみくもに⟦{努力|どりょく}する→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧: to make blind effort
- やみくもな⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧: reckless behavior

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦むやみ→むやみ：20555_muyami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: recklessly, thoughtlessly — very similar; slightly less vivid
- ⟦めちゃくちゃ→めちゃくちゃ：05178_mechakucha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in a completely disorderly way — more extreme and chaotic
- がむしゃら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: desperately, single-mindedly — implies determined effort rather than aimlessness
- {盲目的|もうもくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: blindly — more formal; often used for beliefs or loyalty
